name: swap-players
description: Claim a free agent and drop a rostered player from the Players tab. Uses the position chips (QB, RB, WR, TE, W/R/T, K, DEF) to find the add, then the Claim button on its row, then the drop checkbox on the Add Player sheet. Nothing is committed until the final Confirm Claim tap, which is a roster change. Start on the league page (Team, Matchup, Players tabs visible). Params: add_player (e.g. C. Tate), add_filter (position chip, e.g. WR), drop_player (e.g. K. Pitts Sr.). Player search is not used.
